Container.Name: odometer
Container.Overview: Odometer: a self-hosted car tracker for fuel fill-ups, maintenance, insurance and registration. One container serves the app and its API; all data lives in the appdata folder. There is no sign-in, so keep it on your LAN or behind your reverse proxy's authentication.

Config.Name: WebUI port
Config.Description: Port for the app and its API.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Holds odometer.db (and receipts later). Back this folder up.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User the server runs as and owner of the appdata folder. 99 is unraid's nobody.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group for the same. 100 is unraid's users.
